selection: 10 major food/feed products chosen by farm cash receipts, international supply and geographic reading; hay and pasture are auxiliary measures, not added products. This is not a mixed-unit numerical ranking.

sourceScope.census: 8 main products plus hay/pasture; exact retained 2021 CSV rows joined by DGUID; 1747 covered CCS and 10 uncovered territorial polygons.
sourceScope.pork: 3 published rounded province inventory percentages; national 13.98 million head is a separate source value; 2025 edition, Jan 1 date as stated without inferring a reference year.
sourceScope.chicken: 2021 CFC producer counts published by AAFC; 10 province values and separately published national total. Not bird numbers, output or Census farms.

blockedAcquisition: No CCS pork or chicken values were acquired; none are inferred or allocated from province figures.
reproduction: Rerun data-source/atlas/canada-census-2021/convert.mjs with the retained official source cache for CCS. Provincial supplement is an attributed factual transcription of inspected source tables. No raw HTML snapshot is claimed.
